api_keys_agent_check.name: api_keys_agent_check
api_keys_agent_check.value: "api_keys"."agent_id" IS NULL OR ("api_keys"."kind" = 'service' AND "api_keys"."workspace_id" IS NOT NULL)

api_keys_personal_check.name: api_keys_personal_check
api_keys_personal_check.value: "api_keys"."kind" <> 'personal' OR ("api_keys"."created_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "api_keys"."workspace_id" IS NOT NULL)

control_intents_interrupt_target_check.name: control_intents_interrupt_target_check
control_intents_interrupt_target_check.value: "control_intents"."kind" <> 'interrupt' OR ("control_intents"."target_turn_id" IS NOT NULL AND "control_intents"."attempt_id" IS NOT NULL)

grants_actions_resource_check.name: grants_actions_resource_check
grants_actions_resource_check.value: "grants"."actions" <@ CASE "resource_kind" WHEN 'workspace' THEN ARRAY['workspace.read','workspace.manage','agent.manage','binding.manage','routine.manage','memory.read','memory.write']::text[] WHEN 'session' THEN ARRAY['session.read','session.submit','session.approve','session.control','session.recover','artifact.read','delivery.send']::text[] WHEN 'invite' THEN ARRAY[]::text[] WHEN 'agent' THEN ARRAY['agent.manage','binding.manage','routine.manage','memory.read','memory.write']::text[] WHEN 'agent_release' THEN ARRAY[]::text[] WHEN 'surface_binding' THEN ARRAY['binding.manage','session.submit','delivery.send']::text[] WHEN 'session_link' THEN ARRAY['session.read','session.submit','session.approve','session.control','delivery.send']::text[] WHEN 'dispatch' THEN ARRAY[]::text[] WHEN 'memory' THEN ARRAY['memory.read','memory.write']::text[] WHEN 'routine' THEN ARRAY['routine.manage']::text[] WHEN 'artifact' THEN ARRAY['artifact.read']::text[] ELSE ARRAY[]::text[] END

grants_id_length_check.name: grants_id_length_check
grants_id_length_check.value: length("grants"."actor_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND ("grants"."service_principal_id" IS NULL OR length("grants"."service_principal_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 128) AND length("grants"."resource_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 512 AND length("grants"."audience_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 512

linked_accounts_revoked_check.name: linked_accounts_revoked_check
linked_accounts_revoked_check.value: ("linked_accounts"."status" = 'revoked') = ("linked_accounts"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("linked_accounts"."status" = 'revoked') = ("linked_accounts"."revoked_reason" IS NOT NULL)

login_methods_external_check.name: login_methods_external_check
login_methods_external_check.value: CASE WHEN "login_methods"."kind" = 'password' THEN "login_methods"."issuer" IS NULL AND "login_methods"."subject" IS NULL ELSE "login_methods"."issuer" IS NOT NULL AND "login_methods"."subject" IS NOT NULL END

pending_requests_undelivered_attempt_idx.name: pending_requests_undelivered_attempt_idx
pending_requests_undelivered_attempt_idx.where: "pending_requests"."answered_at" IS NOT NULL AND "pending_requests"."settled_at" IS NULL

pending_requests_approval_check.name: pending_requests_approval_check
pending_requests_approval_check.value: ("pending_requests"."answer_surface" IS NULL) = ("pending_requests"."answer_decision_id" IS NULL) AND ("pending_requests"."answer_surface" IS NULL OR "pending_requests"."answered_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("pending_requests"."answered_by" IS NULL OR "pending_requests"."answer_surface" IS NOT NULL)

push_requests_decision_check.name: push_requests_decision_check
push_requests_decision_check.value: ("push_requests"."state" = 'requested') = ("push_requests"."decided_at" IS NULL) AND ("push_requests"."decided_at" IS NULL) = ("push_requests"."decided_by" IS NULL) AND ("push_requests"."decided_at" IS NULL) = ("push_requests"."decision_receipt_id" IS NULL)

sessions_repository_mode_check.name: sessions_repository_mode_check
sessions_repository_mode_check.value: ("sessions"."repository_mode" = 'repository' AND "sessions"."repo_url" IS NOT NULL AND "sessions"."branch" IS NOT NULL) OR ("sessions"."repository_mode" = 'none' AND "sessions"."repository_id" IS NULL AND "sessions"."repo_url" IS NULL AND "sessions"."branch" IS NULL)

slack_apps_created_check.name: slack_apps_created_check
slack_apps_created_check.value: "slack_apps"."state" NOT IN ('created', 'deleting', 'deleted') OR ("slack_apps"."app_id" IS NOT NULL AND "slack_apps"."client_id" IS NOT NULL)

slack_inbound_events_dropped_check.name: slack_inbound_events_dropped_check
slack_inbound_events_dropped_check.value: ("slack_inbound_events"."status" = 'dropped') = ("slack_inbound_events"."drop_reason" IS NOT NULL) AND ("slack_inbound_events"."status" = 'dropped') = ("slack_inbound_events"."payload" IS NULL)

slack_inbound_events_claim_check.name: slack_inbound_events_claim_check
slack_inbound_events_claim_check.value: ("slack_inbound_events"."claim_token" IS NULL) = ("slack_inbound_events"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL) AND ("slack_inbound_events"."status" = 'received' OR "slack_inbound_events"."claim_token" IS NULL)

slack_installations_verified_check.name: slack_installations_verified_check
slack_installations_verified_check.value: "slack_installations"."status" <> 'verified' OR ("slack_installations"."bot_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "slack_installations"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL)

slack_outbox_claim_check.name: slack_outbox_claim_check
slack_outbox_claim_check.value: ("slack_outbox"."claim_token" IS NULL) = ("slack_outbox"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL) AND ("slack_outbox"."status" IN ('pending', 'sending') OR "slack_outbox"."claim_token" IS NULL) AND ("slack_outbox"."status" <> 'sending' OR "slack_outbox"."claim_token" IS NOT NULL)

surface_bindings_dm_check.name: surface_bindings_dm_check
surface_bindings_dm_check.value: "surface_bindings"."surface_kind" IS DISTINCT FROM 'dm' OR ("surface_bindings"."external_surface_id" IS NULL AND NOT "surface_bindings"."home")

surface_bindings_ready_check.name: surface_bindings_ready_check
surface_bindings_ready_check.value: "surface_bindings"."surface" <> 'slack' OR "surface_bindings"."status" <> 'ready' OR ("surface_bindings"."installation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "surface_bindings"."surface_kind" IS NOT NULL AND ("surface_bindings"."external_surface_id" IS NOT NULL OR "surface_bindings"."surface_kind" = 'dm'))

worker_launches_open_session_idx.name: worker_launches_open_session_idx
worker_launches_open_session_idx.where: "worker_launches"."slot_released_at" IS NULL AND "worker_launches"."session_id" IS NOT NULL
